title: Two long Sonnet sessions are costed a fifth too low
what: relay calibrate puts two long Sonnet sessions (both 266k-278k context) about 20.8% under Claude Code's total. The cause is not known: a long-context price that prices.toml lacks is a suspicion, to be verified before any price is changed.
why: Cost reports for long sessions may be wrong by about a fifth.
failing_case: `relay calibrate` on the 21 Oct ledger: 2 Sonnet sessions (of 15 sessions in all), both at 266k-278k context, are 20.8% under Claude Code's total; should be within 5% (v3 #2). First step: measure whether the gap comes from a long-context price before changing one.
